Courses Offered
Panigaon OPD College
offers Four-Year Undergraduate Programmes (FYUGP) under the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS), designed to provide students with multidisciplinary knowledge, academic flexibility, and skill-oriented learning opportunities.
The college currently offers Major and Minor courses through the following eight departments:
English
Assamese
Education
Economics
History
Political Science
Sociology
Philosophy
Programme Highlights
The Four-Year Undergraduate Programme aims to develop students’ intellectual, analytical, communication, and research skills while preparing them for higher education, competitive examinations, entrepreneurship, and diverse career opportunities.
Each department is committed to providing quality education through classroom teaching, seminars, group discussions, project work, field-based learning, and co-curricular activities. The curriculum is designed in accordance with the guidelines of the National Education Policy (NEP) and the affiliating university.
Students have the flexibility to choose Major and Minor combinations according to their academic interests and career aspirations, enabling a holistic and interdisciplinary learning experience.
